facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine to Warwick the smith in exchange for the loan of his mithril shirt. Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral and keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use every night meanwhile.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's heirloom that he never even let Ingrid touch.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. It looks natural but can be dug through, and Dunk has partly cleared it, uncovering a dead dwarf.
